Team —

Quick handoff for a closed pilot with Aegis Health (Deal ID: DEAL-9731). High level: they signed a 6-week pilot focused on medication-safety assistant (MVP) for 2 hospitals. ARR is modest — primary objective is to validate latency and integration with their EHR export.

Key contextual bullets:
- Contract SOW attached (SOW_Aegis_v1.pdf) and mutual action plan (Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx).
- Customer contacts: Lena Morales (clinical operations), Bob King (procurement).
- Target kickoff: week of Aug 3; customer wants a short technical discovery before kickoff.
- Data: they'll provide a daily export (FHIR HL7) and require our private deployment option for PHI — legal has approved on a template basis but there will be a short security checklist.

Asks for CS: please pick an onboarding owner and an implementation lead. Priorities for first 30 days: secure test environment, ingest pipeline demo, pre-kickoff tech call with their SREs, and acceptance criteria for pilot.

Logistics/risks: procurement asked for an updated SOW redline and a DocuSign link for signatures. I dropped the initial SOW and MAP in this thread.

Owners proposed (open to swaps):
- Implementation lead: Marissa Cole
- Technical lead / EHR integration: Karthik Iyer
- Customer success owner / primary contact: Priyom Das

Lena/Bob — looping you in so you have CS owners. Priyom/Marissa/Karthik — can we confirm owners and a tentative 60-minute kickoff on Aug 4 or 5?

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0143

All —

I’ll take implementation lead as proposed. Drafting a compact 30/60/90 plan and RACI; I’ll include milestones that map to the mutual action plan. Quick notes from my side:

30-day (kickoff -> staging):
- Provision test tenant, enable private deployment flags, invite Aegis test users.
- Baseline latency test with sample payloads.
- Confirm EHR export schema and transformation (FHIR subset).

60-day (staging -> pilot execution):
- Run end-to-end ingestion from their test export, validate outputs vs acceptance cases, iterate prompts/ensembling.
- Provide daily runbook and monitoring dashboard access to Aegis SREs.

90-day (pilot close -> metrics handoff):
- Collect success metrics (latency P95, inference cost per request, clinical accuracy signals).
- Prepare go/no-go recommendations for expansion.

Redlines and procurement: I see a few small SOW edits we should accept (liability cap language + pilot acceptance window). Logan — can you surface the procurement lead’s preferred terms? We should not delay the kickoff over small redlines but will need an agreed DocuSign window.

Attaching an internal kickoff checklist (I'll upload to the drive).

Marissa Cole
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick handoff. A few items on our side:

1) Kickoff window: Aug 3 or 4 works best for our clinical team. Prefer morning ET.
2) Security/compliance: we'll need the completed security questionnaire and network requirements (firewall egress, IP ranges) in advance of provisioning. Can you point me to the security doc or send network_requirements.pdf?
3) Data flow: we'll provide a nightly FHIR bundle dump. Is there a preferred format/schema for the ingest? Also confirm whether the private deployment option implies our data remains in our cloud account or if Redwood will manage a private instance (we need detail for our security team).

On procurement: Bob will follow up on the DocuSign once you resend.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Hi Lena & team —

Thanks — I can own the technical discovery. Two quick answers and a proposed plan:

1) Network requirements: attaching network_requirements.pdf to this reply (egress ports, IP allowlist, certs). If you prefer the private deployment where the instance runs in your cloud account, that is an option but will add provisioning steps (we'll need IAM roles and a small infra template).

2) FHIR ingest: we prefer a compressed NDJSON export of the subset (Patient, Encounter, MedicationRequest, Observation) — our integration template is in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aegis-Handoff-SharedDocs. I will paste a small example schema in the pre-kick discovery doc.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Tech discovery call: Aug 1, 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET (30–45m) — confirm and I’ll send calendar invite with an agenda.
- Provide network_requirements.pdf and a brief infra checklist before the call.
- I'll compile a short runbook for data mapping and error scenarios by Jul 24.

Marissa/Priyom — please advise if you want me to include service-level dashboards and tracing endpoints in the first delivery wave (I recommend yes for pilot transparency).

Karthik Iyer
Lead Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference
